quality_metrics.collected_by: Texas A&M University Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital Clinical Microbiology Laboratory

curation.notes: GenomeTrakr isolate ISO000080430 (SEQSEQ000070406). Strain ECOL-17-VL-LA-TX-0026. Isolation: Bite wound from Canis lupus familiaris (2017-07). Assembly not available - generate locally.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR6875395 && mv data/SRR6875395_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR6875395_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.notes: Assembly not available in NCBI. Generate locally: spades.py -1 data/reads_1.fq.gz -2 data/reads_2.fq.gz -o assembly/ --careful && cp assembly/contigs.fasta data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype O15:H18 and ST69 (phylogroup D). Accept exact match. ExPEC virulence profile: hlyA, cnf1. Less virulent than B2 ExPEC but established pathogenic lineage.
validation_instructions.mlst: Run mlst with 'ecoli' scheme. Expected ST69 (phylogroup D). Accept exact match.

notes: Classic ST69 serotype O15:H18. Phylogroup D ExPEC causing UTI and bacteremia. Dog bite wound isolate (Texas 2017). Less virulent than ST95/ST73 but clinically relevant. Veterinary ExPEC from dog infection.
